test_title: PYST 41: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 21 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the following triads, each group of letters is related to the subsequent one following a certain logic. Select from the given options, the one that follows the same logic.

ARCE - CARE - ECRA

POLE - LPOE - ELOP
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

ARCE - CARE - ECRA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b89fbc9ae08936da7e0334a3cb8595716125cc1d9ede7ce4e8209a4d7faadac.png] 

And,

POLE - LPOE - ELOP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c720126f9a67a87eaa0e8acb3e9eb4d2590b1709113345f4979593a643bcce6.png] 

​Similarly,

Option 3) WORM - RWOM - MROW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ddff545fbf3fd4d029f8b8bb99fc74b46ead1ed82589c899df40cb6f54e83385.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
